summary: Outlook Therapeutics filed an Item 8.01 Form 8-K disclosing that on September 16, 2026 it established a U.S. wholesale acquisition cost for LYTENAVA (bevacizumab-vikg) of $485 per vial. No securities, ownership, or transaction terms are involved; the filing is a routine commercial pricing disclosure signed by CFO Kevin Lundquist. The 8-K thereby amends no prior special-situation event and carries no board recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory clock. For event-driven desks there is no deal or risk-arb angle; watch only for launch execution, payer coverage and reimbursement updates affecting OTLK commercialization.
